name: Time of Day
description: Detects time-of-day values in 12-hour (hh:mm am/pm) or 24-hour (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS) format. Under HIPAA, times of service, procedure, or medication are Protected Health Information when combined with other patient identifiers. Low severity — bare times are ambiguous without surrounding context.

metadata.note: Two-digit hour required to reduce false positives from version strings and other colon-separated numeric patterns. Companion to personal.datetime_iso8601 for full timestamps.
